request.spec:

agent.result_text:
I added a year box and a "Generate quarters" button next to the existing monthly and fiscal-year generators. All 4 acceptance tests pass in `bin/e2e`.

**What it does:** you enter a year (yyyy) and press the button. The app adds up to four periods, `<yyyy>-Q1` to `<yyyy>-Q4`, each running from the first day of its quarter to the last. A quarter is skipped if its name is already used on the sheet or its dates overlap an existing period. This is the same check the period form uses. Each period it adds writes a `PERIOD_ADDED` record to the audit file, and the screen shows how many were made. A year that isn't yyyy shows an error and writes nothing.

In the test, a period covering 1–10 May 2026 already exists, so generating 2026 makes 3 (Q2 is skipped). Pressing it again makes 0.

**Changes:**
- **Endpoint:** `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/periods/generate-quarters`, defined in `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/sheets/{sheetId}/periods/generate-quarters.POST.yml`. It reuses the existing `RespondWithGeneratedPeriods` step.
- **Server classes** in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/period/`: `ValidateGenerateQuarters`, `GenerateQuarters`, `GenerateQuartersRequest` and `GenerateQuartersValues`.
- **Front end** in `src/main/frontend/features/periods/periods.slot.tsx`: the new input and button share the existing made-count and error display with the other generators.

There was no database change, because the existing period table already holds what's needed.
